blocks.zh: 配管系統設計、製作施工程序與專業術語定義總覽
blocks.en: Piping System Design, Fabrication Procedures and Definitions of Technical Terms: Overview

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 了解 WFI/PW 配送系統的設計原則：管件選用、自然排水坡度、死角控制
blocks.en: Understand the design principles of WFI/PW distribution systems: fitting selection, self-draining slope and dead leg control

blocks.zh: 掌握高純水配管系統的完整施工程序：從來料檢驗、清潔保護到焊接環境控制
blocks.en: Master the complete installation procedure for high-purity water piping, from incoming inspection and cleaning/protection to weld environment control

blocks.zh: 理解軌道焊接（Orbital Welding）技術原理、焊接標準與焊工資格認證要求
blocks.en: Understand the principles of orbital welding, weld acceptance criteria and welder qualification requirements

blocks.zh: 辨識 14 種常見焊接缺陷的成因與矯正措施，建立品質判斷能力
blocks.en: Identify the causes and corrective actions for 14 common weld defects, and build the ability to judge weld quality

blocks.zh: 了解 PVDF 管件焊接的特殊要求與缺陷焊縫的處理程序
blocks.en: Understand the special requirements for welding PVDF piping and the procedure for handling defective welds

blocks.zh: 熟悉製藥用水系統的完整專業術語與縮寫，作為日常工作參考工具
blocks.en: Become familiar with the full set of terms and abbreviations used in pharmaceutical water systems, as a day-to-day reference

blocks.zh: 11.10 Design of a WFI/Purified Water Distribution System 11.10 注射用水/純化水分配系統設計
blocks.en: 11.10 Design of a WFI/Purified Water Distribution System

blocks.zh: 配送系統設計的核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principles of Distribution System Design

blocks.zh: 高純水配送系統設計必須同時滿足三大要求：
blocks.en: The design of a high-purity water distribution system must meet three requirements at the same time:

blocks.zh: 可排水性（Drainability）：所有管線必須能完全排空，避免死水區域
blocks.en: Drainability: all piping must be fully drainable, to avoid stagnant areas

blocks.zh: 防微生物增長：消除死角（dead legs）、確保持續流動
blocks.en: Prevention of microbial growth: eliminate dead legs and ensure continuous flow

blocks.zh: 材質相容性：所有接觸面使用不鏽鋼或合格非金屬材料
blocks.en: Material compatibility: all contact surfaces must be stainless steel or qualified non-metallic materials

blocks.zh: 關鍵數值記憶
blocks.en: Key Numbers to Remember

blocks.zh: 閥門安裝角度：60° to vertical（非水平安裝），優化排水
blocks.en: Valve installation angle: 60° to vertical (not installed horizontally), to optimize drainage

blocks.zh: Dead leg 最大值：6 倍管徑（從主管中心線到閥門中心線）
blocks.en: Maximum dead leg: 6 pipe diameters (from the main pipe centerline to the valve centerline)

blocks.zh: 最小坡度：1/16 in./ft = 0.52 cm/m
blocks.en: Minimum slope: 1/16 in./ft = 0.52 cm/m

blocks.zh: SS 支撐間距：每 10 ft (3 m) 一個支架
blocks.en: SS support spacing: one support every 10 ft (3 m)

blocks.zh: PVDF 管件：需要連續支撐（因高溫軟化）
blocks.en: PVDF piping: requires continuous support (because it softens at high temperature)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一條山間溪流：設計師希望水流在每一段管路中都能像溪水一樣「自然流動、自然排空」。如果管路有凹陷或水平段，就像溪流中的水潭 -- 水會停滯、微生物就會開始滋生。所以每段管路都必須有明確的坡度，讓水在停機時能靠重力自然排出。
blocks.en: Imagine a mountain stream: the designer wants the water in every section of pipe to "flow naturally and drain naturally" like stream water. If the piping has a sag or a horizontal run, it is like a pool in the stream -- the water stagnates and microorganisms begin to grow. So every section of pipe must have a clear slope, so that the water drains out by gravity when the system is shut down.

blocks.zh: 實務重點：Tri-clamp 設計
blocks.en: Practical Focus: Tri-clamp Design

blocks.zh: Tri-clamp（三片式卡箍）是製藥級管件連接的標準。所有閥門、感測器都應使用 tri-clamp 連接，因為它：
blocks.en: The tri-clamp (three-piece clamp) is the standard for connecting pharmaceutical-grade fittings. All valves and sensors should be connected with tri-clamps because they:

blocks.zh: 提供平整的內壁接觸面（無螺紋死角）
blocks.en: Provide a smooth internal contact surface (no thread crevices)

blocks.zh: 可快速拆裝進行清潔和維護
blocks.en: Can be quickly disassembled for cleaning and maintenance

blocks.zh: 使用 EPDM 或 PTFE 墊片確保密封
blocks.en: Use EPDM or PTFE gaskets to ensure sealing

blocks.zh: 11.11 Fabrication of a WFI/PW Distribution System 11.11 注射用水/純化水分配系統製作
blocks.en: 11.11 Fabrication of a WFI/PW Distribution System

blocks.zh: 施工品質控管的完整鏈條
blocks.en: The Complete Chain of Installation Quality Control

blocks.zh: ISPE 把配管施工視為一個完整的品質鏈條，每一環都不能斷裂：
blocks.en: ISPE treats piping installation as a complete quality chain, in which no link may break:

blocks.zh: 採購控管：使用核准供應商清單（AVL）與指定料號
blocks.en: Procurement control: use an approved vendor list (AVL) and specified part numbers

blocks.zh: 到貨檢驗：逐件比對 Bill of Lading
blocks.en: Receiving inspection: check each item against the Bill of Lading

blocks.zh: 清潔準備：IPA 清洗 + 無塵布擦拭
blocks.en: Cleaning preparation: IPA cleaning + wiping with lint-free cloths

blocks.zh: 保護措施：2 小時內未焊接必須封袋
blocks.en: Protective measures: components not welded within 2 hours must be bagged

blocks.zh: 焊接環境：潔淨室內操作，禁止碳鋼設備
blocks.en: Welding environment: work in a clean room; carbon steel equipment is prohibited

blocks.zh: 保護氣體：99.999% 純度氬氣
blocks.en: Shielding gas: 99.999% purity argon

blocks.zh: 人員資格：每日開工前須重新認證
blocks.en: Personnel qualification: re-qualification is required before work starts each day

blocks.zh: 為什麼不能混用碳鋼設備？
blocks.en: Why Must Carbon Steel Equipment Not Be Mixed In?

blocks.zh: 碳鋼微粒如果殘留在不鏽鋼管內壁，會形成電偶腐蝕（Galvanic Corrosion）的起始點。即使是肉眼不可見的微量碳鋼碎屑，也能在高純水環境中引發 rouge（紅鏽）形成，進而污染整個水系統。
blocks.en: If carbon steel particles remain on the inner wall of stainless steel piping, they become the starting point of galvanic corrosion. Even trace carbon steel debris that is invisible to the naked eye can trigger rouge formation in a high-purity water environment and then contaminate the entire water system.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 ISPE 要求施工區域完全隔離碳鋼作業。
blocks.en: This is why ISPE requires the installation area to be completely segregated from carbon steel work.

blocks.zh: 比喻：就像手術室的無菌操作
blocks.en: Analogy: Aseptic Practice in an Operating Room

blocks.zh: 高純水配管施工就像外科手術：管件是「器官」，焊接區是「手術室」，氬氣是「無菌環境」，IPA 清潔是「消毒擦拭」。外科醫師不會用碰過地面的手術刀，同理，施工人員也不能用接觸過碳鋼的工具。
blocks.en: Installing high-purity water piping is like performing surgery: the fittings are the "organs", the weld area is the "operating room", the argon is the "sterile environment", and IPA cleaning is the "disinfecting wipe". A surgeon would not use a scalpel that has touched the floor; likewise, installers must not use tools that have touched carbon steel.

blocks.zh: 2 小時的封袋時限就像手術器械的有效無菌期 -- 超過時間就必須重新準備。
blocks.en: The 2-hour bagging time limit is like the sterile shelf life of surgical instruments -- once the time is exceeded, they must be prepared again.

blocks.zh: 氬氣純度要求 -- 99.999%
blocks.en: Argon Purity Requirement -- 99.999%

blocks.zh: 這個「五個 9」的純度要求代表：
blocks.en: This "five nines" purity requirement means:

blocks.zh: 水分 < 1 ppm
blocks.en: Moisture < 1 ppm

blocks.zh: 氧氣 < 2 ppm
blocks.en: Oxygen < 2 ppm

blocks.zh: 使用液態氬氣（Dewar 瓶）比高壓鋼瓶更佳，因為液態氬氣在蒸發過程中自然達到極高純度。搭配 Nanochem 等氣體純化器可將雜質降至 ppb 等級。
blocks.en: Liquid argon (Dewar flasks) is better than high-pressure cylinders, because liquid argon naturally reaches very high purity as it evaporates. Combined with a gas purifier such as Nanochem, impurities can be reduced to the ppb level.

blocks.zh: 11.11.3 Clean Preparation Area 11.11.3 潔淨準備區
blocks.en: 11.11.3 Clean Preparation Area

blocks.zh: 「驗證焊接」的概念（Validated Weld）
blocks.en: The Concept of the Validated Weld

blocks.zh: ISPE 的核心理念是：與其事後逐一檢查每條焊縫，不如驗證整個焊接製程。如果以下條件都受到控制：
blocks.en: ISPE's core idea is that, rather than inspecting every weld one by one after the fact, it is better to validate the whole welding process. If the following conditions are all controlled:

blocks.zh: 焊接機台參數已驗證
blocks.en: Welding machine parameters are validated

blocks.zh: 焊接環境潔淨受控
blocks.en: The welding environment is clean and controlled

blocks.zh: 材料表面清潔
blocks.en: Material surfaces are clean

blocks.zh: 保護氣體純度達標
blocks.en: Shielding gas purity meets the requirement

blocks.zh: 焊工通過每日資格認證
blocks.en: Welders pass daily qualification

blocks.zh: 則可合理推定產出的焊縫品質一致且合格。這與製藥業的 Process Validation 思維完全一致。
blocks.en: then it is reasonable to presume that the welds produced are consistent and acceptable. This is entirely consistent with Process Validation thinking in the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: 半導體業的啟示
blocks.en: Lessons from the Semiconductor Industry

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別引用半導體業的做法並非偶然。半導體製程對潔淨度的要求甚至比製藥更嚴格，而他們已經證明潔淨施工區是降低成本的有效方法 -- 因為減少了返工、報廢和品質問題。
blocks.en: It is no coincidence that ISPE specifically cites semiconductor industry practice. Semiconductor processes demand even stricter cleanliness than pharmaceuticals, and the industry has already shown that a clean installation area is an effective way to reduce cost -- because it reduces rework, scrap and quality problems.

blocks.zh: 製藥業可以直接借鏡這套成熟做法，不需要自己摸索。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical industry can borrow directly from this mature practice, without having to work it out for itself.

blocks.zh: 為什麼手指油脂是大敵？
blocks.en: Why Is Finger Grease the Enemy?

blocks.zh: 人體皮膚油脂（主要是脂肪酸和角鯊烯）在焊接高溫下會分解產生碳化物。這些碳化物會：
blocks.en: Human skin oils (mainly fatty acids and squalene) decompose at welding temperatures to produce carbides. These carbides will:

blocks.zh: 嵌入焊縫金屬中形成夾渣
blocks.en: Become embedded in the weld metal as inclusions

blocks.zh: 破壞鈍化膜的形成
blocks.en: Interfere with formation of the passive film

blocks.zh: 成為微生物附著的起點
blocks.en: Become starting points for microbial attachment

blocks.zh: 戴手套不只是「習慣」，而是焊縫品質的基本保障。
blocks.en: Wearing gloves is not just a "habit"; it is a basic safeguard of weld quality.

blocks.zh: 11.11.4–11.11.5 Orbital Welding & Borescoping 11.11.4–11.11.5 軌道焊接與管孔鏡檢查
blocks.en: 11.11.4–11.11.5 Orbital Welding & Borescoping

blocks.zh: 為什麼軌道焊接是業界標準？
blocks.en: Why Is Orbital Welding the Industry Standard?

blocks.zh: 軌道焊接（Orbital Welding）之所以成為高純水系統的首選，有三個關鍵原因：
blocks.en: Orbital welding has become the first choice for high-purity water systems for three key reasons:

blocks.zh: 無填料焊接（Autogenous）：不使用焊條，避免引入外來材料
blocks.en: Autogenous welding: no filler wire is used, so no foreign material is introduced

blocks.zh: 機器控制：焊接參數（電流、速度、脈衝）由程式精確控制，排除人為變異
blocks.en: Machine control: welding parameters (current, speed, pulse) are precisely controlled by program, eliminating human variation

blocks.zh: 內壁品質：特徵性的平滑焊道（smooth inner weld bead），不會形成微生物聚集的凹凸面
blocks.en: Inner wall quality: the characteristic smooth inner weld bead has no irregular surface where microorganisms could accumulate

blocks.zh: TIG 焊接原理簡述
blocks.en: A Brief Look at TIG Welding Principles

blocks.zh: TIG = Tungsten Inert Gas，也叫 GTAW（Gas Tungsten Arc Welding）：
blocks.en: TIG = Tungsten Inert Gas, also called GTAW (Gas Tungsten Arc Welding):

blocks.zh: 鎢電極產生電弧，熔化管壁母材
blocks.en: The tungsten electrode generates the arc, which melts the pipe wall base metal

blocks.zh: 氬氣覆蓋焊接區域，隔絕空氣中的氧氣和水分
blocks.en: Argon covers the weld area, excluding oxygen and moisture from the air

blocks.zh: 管內同步通入背面保護氣（Purge Gas）
blocks.en: Back-purge gas (purge gas) is fed simultaneously inside the pipe

blocks.zh: 焊接頭圍繞管件360° 旋轉（這就是 “Orbital” 的含義）
blocks.en: The weld head rotates 360° around the pipe (this is the meaning of "Orbital")

blocks.zh: Borescope 檢查的定位
blocks.en: The Role of Borescope Inspection

blocks.zh: 注意 ISPE 的立場：在製程驗證完備的前提下，borescope 檢查不是每條焊縫必須做的，而是用於：
blocks.en: Note ISPE's position: provided the process validation is complete, borescope inspection is not required for every weld; it is used for:

blocks.zh: 每日開工前的首件確認
blocks.en: First-piece confirmation before work starts each day

blocks.zh: 更換管徑時的資格認證
blocks.en: Qualification when the pipe size is changed

blocks.zh: 製程問題的抽檢追蹤
blocks.en: Spot-check follow-up of process problems

blocks.zh: 錄影記錄每條焊縫被認為「不必要且難以正當化」-- 這是一個風險導向的務實立場。
blocks.en: Video recording of every weld is regarded as "unnecessary and difficult to justify" -- a pragmatic, risk-based position.

blocks.zh: 思考題
blocks.en: Question to Consider

blocks.zh: 你的工廠要求每條焊縫都錄影存檔。根據 ISPE 的觀點，這個做法是否合理？如果你是品質主管，你會如何平衡「過度檢驗」與「品質保證」之間的關係？
blocks.en: Your site requires every weld to be video-recorded and archived. In ISPE's view, is this practice reasonable? If you were the quality head, how would you balance "over-inspection" against "quality assurance"?

blocks.zh: 11.11.6 Weld Criteria & Welder Qualification 11.11.6 焊接標準與焊工資格
blocks.en: 11.11.6 Weld Criteria & Welder Qualification

blocks.zh: 為什麼內壁凹陷不可接受？
blocks.en: Why Is an Internal Concavity Unacceptable?

blocks.zh: 焊道內壁凹陷（suck-back / concavity）會造成：
blocks.en: Concavity of the inner weld bead (suck-back / concavity) causes:

blocks.zh: 管壁厚度在焊縫處減薄，降低結構強度
blocks.en: Reduced wall thickness at the weld, lowering structural strength

blocks.zh: 凹陷處形成死水區域，微生物容易附著
blocks.en: A stagnant area at the concavity, where microorganisms attach easily

blocks.zh: CIP 清洗液無法有效接觸凹陷底部
blocks.en: CIP solution cannot effectively contact the bottom of the concavity

blocks.zh: 理想的焊縫內壁應該是微微凸起或完全平齊。
blocks.en: An ideal weld inner surface should be slightly convex or completely flush.

blocks.zh: 焊工認證體系
blocks.en: The Welder Qualification System

blocks.zh: ASME B31.3 是化工和石油精煉廠配管標準，引用 ASME Section IX（焊接和釬焊資格標準）。焊工認證的重點：
blocks.en: ASME B31.3 is the piping standard for chemical plants and petroleum refineries, and it references ASME Section IX (welding and brazing qualifications). Key points of welder qualification:

blocks.zh: 每位焊工需持有特定金屬種類和焊接方式的證書
blocks.en: Each welder must hold a certificate for the specific metal type and welding method

blocks.zh: 每日開工前需進行試焊和 borescope 確認
blocks.en: A test weld and borescope confirmation are required before work starts each day

blocks.zh: 更換管徑需重新資格認證
blocks.en: A change of pipe size requires re-qualification

blocks.zh: 這套體系確保的是人員 + 程序 + 設備三位一體的品質保證
blocks.en: This system ensures quality assurance across people + procedure + equipment as a single whole

blocks.zh: 11.11.7 Weld Defect Catalog 11.11.7 焊接缺陷目錄
blocks.en: 11.11.7 Weld Defect Catalog

blocks.zh: 最常見的問題：保護氣體
blocks.en: The Most Common Problem: Shielding Gas

blocks.zh: 14 種缺陷中有 5 種（36%）直接與保護氣體相關。這告訴我們：
blocks.en: Of the 14 defects, 5 (36%) are directly related to shielding gas. This tells us that:

blocks.zh: 氬氣的供應、純度、流量監控是焊接品質的第一道防線
blocks.en: Argon supply, purity and flow monitoring are the first line of defense for weld quality

blocks.zh: 氣管折彎是現場最常見的低級錯誤 -- 簡單但致命
blocks.en: A kinked gas line is the most common elementary mistake on site -- simple but fatal

blocks.zh: 投資氣體純化器（如 Nanochem）的投資報酬率很高
blocks.en: Investing in a gas purifier (such as Nanochem) has a high return on investment

blocks.zh: 「Sugaring」-- 最嚴重的缺陷之一
blocks.en: "Sugaring" -- One of the Most Serious Defects

blocks.zh: Sugaring（糖化）是指焊縫內壁出現粗糙、多孔的氧化物堆積，外觀像砂糖。它代表焊接時完全沒有有效的內部保護氣體。Sugaring 焊縫是完全不可接受的，因為：
blocks.en: Sugaring refers to a rough, porous accumulation of oxide on the inner weld surface that looks like granulated sugar. It means there was no effective internal shielding gas at all during welding. A sugared weld is completely unacceptable, because:

blocks.zh: 粗糙表面提供大量微生物附著點
blocks.en: The rough surface provides many microbial attachment sites

blocks.zh: 氧化物會持續剝落污染水質
blocks.en: The oxide continues to flake off and contaminate the water

blocks.zh: CIP 無法清洗乾淨
blocks.en: CIP cannot clean it thoroughly

blocks.zh: 變色判斷法則
blocks.en: Rules for Judging Discoloration

blocks.zh: 焊縫變色是保護氣問題的「溫度計」：
blocks.en: Weld discoloration is the "thermometer" of shielding gas problems:

blocks.zh: 無色/金色：保護良好（合格）
blocks.en: Colorless/gold: good shielding (acceptable)

blocks.zh: 淡藍色/霧化：微量雜質，邊界情況
blocks.en: Light blue/hazy: trace impurities, borderline case

blocks.zh: 深藍色 + 黑邊：嚴重氧化，不合格
blocks.en: Dark blue + black edges: severe oxidation, unacceptable

blocks.zh: 白色/灰色砂糖狀：完全無保護，報廢
blocks.en: White/gray, sugar-like: no shielding at all, scrap

blocks.zh: 現場排查練習
blocks.en: Field Troubleshooting Exercise

blocks.zh: 情境：你發現連續三條焊縫的內壁都出現不規則的變色帶。根據缺陷目錄，請列出你的排查順序和每一步要檢查什麼？（提示：從 11.11.7.4 到 11.11.7.8 依序分析）
blocks.en: Scenario: you find irregular discolored bands on the inner wall of three consecutive welds. Based on the defect catalog, list your troubleshooting sequence and what to check at each step. (Hint: analyze in order from 11.11.7.4 to 11.11.7.8.)

blocks.zh: 14 種焊接缺陷分類整理
blocks.en: Classification of the 14 Weld Defects

blocks.zh: 這些缺陷可以按根本原因分為四大類：
blocks.en: These defects can be divided by root cause into four categories:

blocks.zh: 11.11.8 PVDF Piping Welding 11.11.8 PVDF 管路焊接
blocks.en: 11.11.8 PVDF Piping Welding

blocks.zh: PVDF 的優勢場景
blocks.en: Where PVDF Has the Advantage

blocks.zh: PVDF 管件不會有 rouge（紅鏽）問題，且耐化學腐蝕。特別適合：
blocks.en: PVDF piping does not have rouge problems and is chemically resistant. It is particularly suitable for:

blocks.zh: 常溫或中溫（≤90°C）PW 系統
blocks.en: Ambient or medium-temperature (≤90°C) PW systems

blocks.zh: 使用臭氧消毒的系統
blocks.en: Systems sanitized with ozone

blocks.zh: 需要避免金屬離子溶出的應用
blocks.en: Applications where leaching of metal ions must be avoided

blocks.zh: 但高溫系統（>90°C）和 WFI 蒸餾系統仍以不鏽鋼為主。
blocks.en: However, high-temperature systems (>90°C) and WFI distillation systems still rely mainly on stainless steel.

blocks.zh: 11.11.9 Remedial Action for Defective Welds 11.11.9 缺陷焊接的矯正措施
blocks.en: 11.11.9 Remedial Action for Defective Welds

blocks.zh: 絕對原則：不修補，只替換
blocks.en: Absolute Principle: Replace, Do Not Repair

blocks.zh: 這是高純水焊接的鐵律：不合格的焊縫必須整段切除重焊，不允許在原焊縫上修補。原因：
blocks.en: This is an iron rule of high-purity water welding: a nonconforming weld must be cut out and re-welded as a whole section; repairing on the original weld is not allowed. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 修補焊接會在同一區域形成多重熱影響區（HAZ）
blocks.en: Repair welding creates multiple heat-affected zones (HAZ) in the same area

blocks.zh: 重複加熱改變金屬微觀結構，降低耐蝕性
blocks.en: Repeated heating changes the metal microstructure and lowers corrosion resistance

blocks.zh: 修補焊縫的內壁品質幾乎不可能達到標準
blocks.en: The inner wall quality of a repaired weld can hardly ever meet the standard

blocks.zh: 替換焊縫的 7 步驟流程
blocks.en: The 7-Step Weld Replacement Procedure

blocks.zh: ISPE 規定的標準流程是一個完整的品質循環：
blocks.en: The standard procedure specified by ISPE is a complete quality cycle:

blocks.zh: 步驟 a-b：切除 + 保留樣品（用於根因分析）
blocks.en: Steps a-b: cut out + retain the sample (for root cause analysis)

blocks.zh: 步驟 c-d：確認 HAZ 完全移除（變色區域必須全部切掉）
blocks.en: Steps c-d: confirm the HAZ is completely removed (all discolored areas must be cut away)

blocks.zh: 步驟 e-f：重新準備管端 + 按標準程序重焊
blocks.en: Steps e-f: re-prepare the pipe ends + re-weld according to the standard procedure

blocks.zh: 步驟 g：追蹤標記 -- 替換焊縫加「R」後綴，確保完整的焊縫履歷
blocks.en: Step g: traceability marking -- add an "R" suffix to the replacement weld, to ensure a complete weld history

blocks.zh: 為什麼要保留被切除的焊縫？
blocks.en: Why Retain the Weld That Was Cut Out?

blocks.zh: 就像醫院保留切除的組織做病理分析一樣，保留不合格焊縫可以：
blocks.en: Just as a hospital keeps excised tissue for pathological analysis, retaining the nonconforming weld makes it possible to:

blocks.zh: 進行根因分析（是參數問題？氣體問題？材料問題？）
blocks.en: Perform root cause analysis (a parameter problem? a gas problem? a material problem?)

blocks.zh: 作為焊工再培訓的教學樣品
blocks.en: Use it as a teaching sample for welder retraining

blocks.zh: 累積缺陷數據，優化焊接程式
blocks.en: Accumulate defect data and optimize the welding program

blocks.zh: 11.11.10 Joints Using Sanitary Clamps 11.11.10 衛生夾管接頭
blocks.en: 11.11.10 Joints Using Sanitary Clamps

blocks.zh: Sanitary Clamp 的適用場景
blocks.en: Where Sanitary Clamps Apply

blocks.zh: Sanitary clamp（衛生卡箍）用於需要定期拆卸維護的連接點：
blocks.en: Sanitary clamps are used at connection points that require periodic disassembly for maintenance:

blocks.zh: 閥門連接（需定期更換膜片）
blocks.en: Valve connections (diaphragms must be replaced periodically)

blocks.zh: 感測器外殼（需定期校準/更換）
blocks.en: Sensor housings (periodic calibration/replacement needed)

blocks.zh: 取樣點（需定期消毒）
blocks.en: Sampling points (periodic sanitization needed)

blocks.zh: 無法進行軌道焊接的管件連接
blocks.en: Fitting connections where orbital welding is not possible

blocks.zh: 設計原則：能焊接的地方用焊接（永久、無死角），不能焊接的地方才用 clamp。
blocks.en: Design principle: weld wherever welding is possible (permanent, no dead legs); use a clamp only where welding is not possible.

blocks.zh: Clamp 接頭的維護要點
blocks.en: Maintenance Points for Clamp Joints

blocks.zh: 墊片（gasket）是唯一消耗件，需定期檢查和更換
blocks.en: The gasket is the only consumable item and must be inspected and replaced periodically

blocks.zh: EPDM 墊片適合熱水，PTFE 適合臭氧環境
blocks.en: EPDM gaskets suit hot water; PTFE suits ozone environments

blocks.zh: 安裝時確保墊片居中，避免突入管內形成死角
blocks.en: During installation, make sure the gasket is centered and does not protrude into the pipe, which would create a dead leg

blocks.zh: clamp 扭矩要適當 -- 過鬆漏水，過緊壓壞墊片
blocks.en: Clamp torque must be appropriate -- too loose leaks, too tight crushes the gasket

blocks.zh: 11.12 Abbreviations and Definitions 11.12 縮寫與定義
blocks.en: 11.12 Abbreviations and Definitions

blocks.zh: 中文對照與重點解說
blocks.en: Chinese Equivalents and Key Explanations

blocks.zh: 易混淆術語提醒
blocks.en: Reminder on Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: Conductivity vs. Resistivity：互為倒數。高純水用 Resistivity（MΩ-cm），一般水用 Conductivity（μS/cm）
blocks.en: Conductivity vs. Resistivity: reciprocals of each other. High-purity water uses resistivity (MΩ-cm); ordinary water uses conductivity (μS/cm)

blocks.zh: Calibration vs. Qualification：Calibration 是儀器精度校準；Qualification 是設備功能確認
blocks.en: Calibration vs. Qualification: calibration is the accuracy adjustment of an instrument; qualification is confirmation of equipment function

blocks.zh: Commissioning vs. Qualification：Commissioning 是工程試車；Qualification 是 GMP 驗證
blocks.en: Commissioning vs. Qualification: commissioning is engineering start-up; qualification is GMP validation

blocks.zh: 實務上最常遇到的術語
blocks.en: The Terms Most Often Encountered in Practice

blocks.zh: 在日常水系統操作中，以下術語出現頻率最高：
blocks.en: In day-to-day water system operation, the following terms appear most frequently:

blocks.zh: Conductivity / Resistivity：水質監控的核心指標
blocks.en: Conductivity / Resistivity: core indicators for water quality monitoring

blocks.zh: Endotoxin：WFI 的關鍵品質屬性
blocks.en: Endotoxin: a critical quality attribute of WFI

blocks.zh: TOC：有機物監控指標
blocks.en: TOC: indicator for monitoring organic matter

blocks.zh: Passivation：不鏽鋼表面處理
blocks.en: Passivation: stainless steel surface treatment

blocks.zh: Reverse Osmosis：主要純化單元
blocks.en: Reverse Osmosis: the main purification unit

blocks.zh: Rouge -- 不鏽鋼的隱形殺手
blocks.en: Rouge -- The Hidden Killer of Stainless Steel

blocks.zh: Rouge 在 ISPE 定義中很簡潔，但它是水系統長期運營中最常遇到的問題之一。Rouge 的形成與系統溫度、水質、不鏽鋼等級直接相關。高溫 WFI 系統（>80°C）特別容易發生。
blocks.en: Rouge is defined very briefly by ISPE, but it is one of the problems most often encountered in the long-term operation of a water system. Rouge formation is directly related to system temperature, water quality and stainless steel grade. High-temperature WFI systems (>80°C) are particularly prone to it.

blocks.zh: 處理方式：定期鈍化（Passivation）和必要時的除鏽處理（Derouging）。
blocks.en: Treatment: periodic passivation, and derouging when necessary.

blocks.zh: PW vs. WFI -- 規格比較
blocks.en: PW vs. WFI -- Specification Comparison

blocks.zh: WFI 的微生物限度比 PW 嚴格 1000 倍，且多了內毒素要求。
blocks.en: The WFI microbial limit is 1000 times stricter than that of PW, and there is an additional endotoxin requirement.

blocks.zh: 中文對照
blocks.en: Chinese Equivalents

blocks.zh: 蒸餾器類型速查
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Still Types

blocks.zh: ME (Multi-Effect)：多效蒸餾器 -- 最常用於 WFI 製備
blocks.en: ME (Multi-Effect): multi-effect still -- the type most commonly used for WFI production

blocks.zh: VC (Vapor Compression)：蒸汽壓縮蒸餾器 -- 節能型
blocks.en: VC (Vapor Compression): vapor compression still -- energy-saving type

blocks.zh: 兩者都能產出符合 USP WFI 規格的水，ME 較傳統可靠，VC 能耗較低。
blocks.en: Both can produce water that meets the USP WFI specification; ME is the more traditional and reliable option, while VC has lower energy consumption.

blocks.zh: Section Summary 章節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 本章總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 三大核心收穫
blocks.en: Three Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 施工即驗證：ISPE 的理念是透過控制整個施工製程（環境、材料、人員、設備、參數）來確保品質，而非依賴事後逐一檢查每條焊縫。
blocks.en: Installation as validation: ISPE's philosophy is to ensure quality by controlling the entire installation process (environment, materials, personnel, equipment, parameters), rather than relying on inspecting every weld one by one afterwards.

blocks.zh: 零容忍修補：不合格焊縫只能切除重焊，不允許修補。這個看似嚴苛的要求，實際上是最經濟的做法 -- 因為修補焊縫永遠無法達到原始品質。
blocks.en: Zero tolerance for repair: a nonconforming weld can only be cut out and re-welded; repair is not allowed. This seemingly strict requirement is in fact the most economical approach -- because a repaired weld can never reach the original quality.

blocks.zh: 術語是溝通基石：掌握這些標準術語和縮寫，才能與設備供應商、工程顧問、法規審查員順暢溝通。中英對照的掌握尤其重要。
blocks.en: Terminology is the foundation of communication: mastering these standard terms and abbreviations is what allows smooth communication with equipment suppliers, engineering consultants and regulatory reviewers. Mastering the Chinese-English equivalents is especially important.

blocks.en: Self-Check Questions

blocks.en: Can you list the 7 links in the piping installation quality chain?

blocks.en: How many of the 8 major standards for weld quality do you remember?

blocks.zh: 14 種焊接缺陷中，哪些與保護氣體相關？
blocks.en: Of the 14 weld defects, which are related to shielding gas?

blocks.zh: PW 和 WFI 在微生物限度上的差異是多少倍？
blocks.en: By what factor do PW and WFI differ in microbial limits?

blocks.zh: 為什麼不合格焊縫不能修補只能替換？
blocks.en: Why can a nonconforming weld not be repaired, only replaced?
